not_promoted.*-samples.json: per-TID sampler dumps for the accepted telemetry runs are 0.1-3 MB each and are fully summarised by the telemetry JSON (cpu/units/io blocks) plus the promoted intervals files; the ONE sample dump that carries an independent finding (the pre-classifier-fix PostgreSQL set that proves the executor/auxiliary misclassification) IS promoted under pre-classifier-fix/
